# Aether Reach 0.9.0 - Bellwether Afterlight

An original connected episode in the existing Bellwether district. Take the west stairs or Bellwether Local from Arrival Quay. The Afterlight dispatch stands near the eastern market arrival at (-84, 7, -4). Accepting it records the Bellwether checkpoint and tracks the episode; it does not reset existing progress.

Recover a sealed lighting fuse after defeating two guards. Enter the Clockmaker's Arcade through its south doorway, read the electrician's plate, set A/B/C to 3/1/2, and test the circuit. Climb the Theatre service ladder, activate its transmitter, defeat the two boarding guards and hold the roof for 20 seconds. Return to the dispatch to relight the public lanterns and collect 240 credits once.

X uses objects. B closes the plate and ending dialogs. The left stick climbs when attached to the service ladder; X attaches, and A/B lets go. B crouches on the ground and folds the Foldwing in the air. Aiming, firing, reloading and power controls retain their existing bindings. D-pad up shows the next tracked step and, on the same floor, projects bounded collision-checked floor arrows. The atlas and adventure journal also track the doorway, ladder and final return instead of pointing through a ceiling.

The checkpoint save retains earned episode milestones and dial positions. Combat actors and broadcast time are intentionally transient: leaving the encounter or using checkpoint recovery interrupts the attempt; the same console restarts it. Episode guards do not mint repeatable currency or weapon drops. Existing purchases, equipment, 15 rail routes and the other 13 side adventures remain. The episode is one new playable district loop, not a claim of a full campaign or a player-approved AAA vertical slice.

Original switch clicks, a failed-circuit cue, broadcast signals and a final bell phrase use the existing bounded WebAudio mixer. The music reacts to active episode combat. The browser may require normal user activation before audio starts; this release does not bypass browser permission controls.

Automated scope: `tests/afterlight.test.mjs` checks progression, corruption handling, collision, bounded actors, interrupted retries, fixed art pools, a full continuous district route and once-only rewards. `tests/afterlight-browser.py` operates the actual rendered game through an emulated standard Gamepad API without assignments to player position, credits, enemies or mission progress. Physical USB/Bluetooth Xbox, Quest, listening quality and frame-time budgets remain separate open acceptance tasks. Current plan: `planning/AAA-ROADMAP.md` and `roadmap.html`. The v0.3 XLSX remains a historical snapshot.
